title: DeciderSettings
description: Data file content/decider/settings.json: when inhabitants ask the decider (W1595: whatever an inhabitant does not understand becomes a question to the AI; B2487: questions wait without a fixed time limit), and the environment values used until weather (B2) and temperature (B5) exist. Placeholders until Marcel decides.

deadline_ms.description: Service time budget per request (ADR-0006); the core itself never waits for the clock.

max_open_questions.description: Open questions per inhabitant at the same time.

ask_cooldown_hours.description: Game hours before the same inhabitant asks about the same subject again.

Trigger.description: A kind of not-understanding that becomes a question.
